title: Autocorrelation of an Euler-quotient pq-squared sequence
summary: Determine the complete periodic autocorrelation distribution of the source-defined binary sequence derived from Euler quotients modulo pq.

formal_statement.body: Let $p$ and $q$ be distinct odd primes with $p\mid(q-1)$ and $2^{q-1}\not\equiv1\pmod{q^2}$, and let $s$ be the source-defined binary threshold sequence of period $pq^2$ derived from Euler quotients modulo $pq$. Determine $A_s(\tau)$ exactly for every nonzero periodic shift $\tau$, equivalently give the complete autocorrelation value distribution for every admissible pair $(p,q)$.

scope.domain: Binary pq-squared-periodic threshold sequences derived from Euler quotients
assumptions: $s$ is the exact source-defined binary threshold sequence
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected later work gives the exact second-order periodic autocorrelation for all admissible p,q and shifts. A later fourth-order correlation-measure result concerns a different statistic.

progress.summary: The source lists the exact autocorrelation of its pq-squared-periodic binary sequence as an unsolved problem.
